hooks.name: honesty-guard
hooks.description: On save of any file in frontend/, README.md, or docs/, run an honesty check against product.md's required copy and metrics rule.

action.prompt: Check the saved file against .kiro/steering/product.md 'Required UI and docs copy' and the metrics rule. Flag any claim of real or public training recordings, real or AIS vessel data, real-world accuracy, metrics shown without 'on synthetic validation data', confidence shown as a percentage, or hard-coded statistics or confidence values. Quote each offending line with a compliant replacement. If clean, reply 'Honesty check passed'.
